name: BoxComforterFactory
caption: A 3D model of a box-stitched comforter laid flat, viewed from above at a slight angle. The comforter is rectangular with visible box stitch seam lines dividing it into segments. The surface has a colorful patchwork-like fabric print with pastel pink, lavender, blue, and cream tones. The comforter has a slight thickness and soft edges with a visible folded edge at one side.
